preconditions.description: The product of the number of books and the length of each book title is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s_i) == m for s_i in s)
preconditions.description: Each book title has exactly m characters.
All characters in the book titles are uppercase Latin letters.
All book titles are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= idx <= n for idx in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each index in the output is within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: sorted([s[i-1] for i in return_value], key=lambda x: [(ord(c) if j % 2 == 0 else -ord(c)) for j, c in enumerate(x)]) == [s[i-1] for i in return_value]
postconditions.description: The book titles are sorted in asc-desc-ending order based on the specified criteria.
